content.title: How to watch Red Sox vs. Astros: TV channel and streaming options for March 30
content.text: Wilyer Abreu takes a two-game homer streak into the Boston Red Sox’s game versus the Houston Astros at 8:10 p.m. ET on Monday, at Daikin Park. Ranger Suarez (0-0, 0.00 ERA) gets the start for the Red Sox, who are 1-2 this season and fourth in the AL East.
